fields.statement: Verified at 003b4ffad: go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... ./internal/web/... exit 0; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/.*roadmap.*' exit 0 (roadmap --all scripts still widen across the root); rhiza ship generate and rhiza render exit 0 with no changes to tracked files. New TestWebRootRoadmapIsProjectScoped (internal/api/web_roadmap_scope_test.go) registers alpha and beta under one root with their own milestone and change sets, serves WebRootHandler, and checks that /p/<x>/roadmap lists only its own milestone and change sets and that /p/<x>/api/roadmap?all=true returns only its own 2 change sets. Reverting the web_api.go fix (ReadOnlyHandler forces RoadmapRequest.local) makes the test fail with beta's API returning alpha's change sets (4, want 2). The diff touches only web_api.go, the new test and run records; it has no stubs or TODOs.
